rules: Initialize Google Mobile Ads only in the native Android runtime (never in the web app).
Use the test ad unit IDs when BuildConfig.DEBUG is true; production IDs only in release builds.
Banner: adaptive anchored banner, top placement, must not cover the bottom tab navigation.
Interstitial: only at natural breaks; never on app launch or during wallpaper generation.
Rewarded: required before free wallpaper generation/download; grant the action only from the earned-reward callback.
Premium users must never see any ad.
